### GitHub Pull Request #19680 Avoid missing binaries due to default platform requires revision
Changelog: Bugfix: Avoid missing binaries due to default platform requires revision.
Docs: Omit

The new revision was generating missing binaries for users of embeded platform dependencies. Even though the behaviour is correct, we understand that the rebuilding might not be feasible for a niche case like this, so this PR aims to remove the effect of the default revision in the package id computation

Closes https://github.com/conan-io/conan/issues/19679
